summary.headline: Retrograde Lords and War
summary.text: Chapters XX–XXI interpret retrograde motion in the lord of the year and the king’s significator as weakness in the king, citizens, or dominion, then judge war by Mars being direct or retrograde, distinguishing zealous fighters from wandering robbers.
